📌 Moscow, IRNA – The summit of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) has started at Turkmenistan’s Avaza national tourism zone, with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in attendance.

The summit opened on Friday with a group photo featuring the participating leaders, including the presidents of Iran, Russia, Turkmenistan, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan, as well as the prime minister of Armenia.
​
The summit’s agenda includes 15 items. The leaders are expected to adopt a joint statement assessing the CIS’s achievements over the past 35 years and outlining its prospects.
​
Other key topics include cooperation in combating cybercrime, enhancing the CIS’s international image, social development, improving quality of life, and strengthening transport connectivity.
